mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in CPIAUCSL above 3% over two consecutive quarters signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise FEDFUNDS, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 70% of triggered episodes, or FEDFUNDS does not rise after CPIAUCSL exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% signals a significant weakening in aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -2%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and ultimately leads to higher corporate costs and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as markets anticipate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in INDPRO above 0.5% for four consecutive months signals accelerating industrial production, indicating robust economic activity and higher corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month decline in FEDFUNDS below 1% signals an aggressive monetary easing cycle, which lowers risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS drops below 1% in one month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both GDPC1 and HOUST over two months signals strengthening housing and overall demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both rise month-over-month for two consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in PAYEMS by more than 1% month-over-month signals significant job losses, which depresses consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent monthly decline in INDPRO below -0.3% for three consecutive months signals a contraction in industrial production, which reduces corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes.
